# Zombie Panic in Wonderland (low-poly)

> A low-poly 3D browser game made with three.js: hold a ruined road against five waves of zombies and pumpkin monsters, then the Zombie King.

## WebMCP tools

The game page (`/index.html`) registers WebMCP tools with `document.modelContext.registerTool` when the browser has a registry. Both are read-only.

- `describe`: returns `{ description }`, one sentence saying what the page is.
- `get_state`: returns `{ screen, wave, score, hearts, enemies, boss_health }`. `screen` is one of `loading`, `error`, `title`, `intro`, `play`, `paused`, `victory` or `defeat`; `boss_health` is `null` until the boss appears.
